body.name: Finite Gaussian branch programs
body.construction: For best elimination use \(Q_h^{\mathrm E}(\rho,\mu)=\inf_{x\in\mathcal B_h}\sum_i q_i(\rho)(x_i-\mu_i)^2/(2s_i)\). For each \(e\ne h\) and \(j\ne e,h\), use \(Q_{e,j}^{\mathrm T}(\rho,\mu)=\inf\{R_e(x,z;\mu):x\in\mathcal B_e,\ m_j(e;x,z)\ge m_h(e;x,z)\}\).
